purpose: Fixed final-epoch shape logit-offset diagnosis; validation only, no optimization or benchmark admission

rationale: Early probability-loss epochs retain full IoU but reduce hidden IoU. Test whether a positive decision offset recovers hidden extent while retaining full geometry. This hypothesis is not established by early aggregate scores.
interpretation: Exploratory development on reused validation with previously observed benchmark prefix; no untouched confirmation claim
